features: Large Keycaps for Precision Typing: Enjoy a comfortable typing experience with large, easy-to-press keycaps designed for accuracy and speed.
Noise-Free Typing: Experience a quiet work environment with Ki-Pad 3’s noise-free typing, perfect for home offices and shared workspaces.
Multimedia Hotkeys: Conveniently control your media with dedicated hotkeys for volume, play, pause, and track navigation, enhancing your productivity and entertainment.
Full-Sized Layout: The Portronics Ki-Pad 3 features a full-sized layout with a numeric keypad, ideal for both professional and personal use, offering comprehensive functionality.
Ergonomic Design: Reduce strain and fatigue with our ergonomic design, providing comfort for extended typing sessions and promoting better hand posture.
1.5 Meter Long Cable: The extra-long cable provides flexibility and freedom, allowing you to easily connect to your device without feeling restricted.
description: Discover the perfect blend of precision and comfort with the Ki-Pad 3 wired keyboard. Designed with large keycaps, it ensures effortless typing for all users. Enjoy a peaceful work environment with its noise-free typing, ideal for home offices and shared workspaces. Boost your productivity with dedicated multimedia hotkeys, allowing you to easily control volume, play, pause, and other controls. Featuring a full-sized layout with a numeric keypad, the Ki-Pad 3 keyboard provides comprehensive functionality for both professional and personal use. Its ergonomic design reduces strain and fatigue, promoting better hand posture during extended use. The 1.5-meter long cable offers the flexibility and freedom to connect without restrictions.
